bugs_found: apply_fee overwrites any fee below fee_max to fee_max, so it always charges the maximum fee instead of clamping between min and max
fx_convert does not validate that FX rates are positive, allowing zero or negative conversion outputs
transfer does not normalize amount to Decimal, so float inputs can cause TypeError during debit/credit and precision/type inconsistencies in receipts
compound_interest and loan_payment silently truncate years/months/compounds_per_year via int(), causing undeclared behavior changes for non-integer inputs
